strategy.objective: Use the relaunch of teddyheadwear.com to build awareness and traffic: introduce the hat line and its details, make Monogram Studio the reason to visit, launch the apparel drop, and end with a community that posts its own Teddy photos.
audience: Style-led 25–40 year olds in South Florida who live near the coast and want a hat that works at the beach and at dinner
Modern Western fans who like the silhouette but want something less costume, more everyday
Gift buyers looking for something personal (Monogram Studio, someone else's initials)
People who care about details and will pay for wool, silk and leather
City dwellers with ties to Texas, Florida, New York or Los Angeles who want the monogram for their place
strategy.positioning: Teddy Headwear is a Western hat brand born in Jupiter, Florida: traditional silhouettes, contemporary design and original embroidered artwork, on 100% wool with gold silk inside. A new frontier: Western hats that make sense on the Atlantic coast and in the city, now with your own letters on them.

pillars.name: The Hats
pillars.why: Show the cowboy and fedora range, prices and product pages clearly so new followers know what they can buy.

pillars.name: The Monogram
pillars.why: City monograms and Monogram Studio are the brand's most distinctive hook and the new site's main feature.

pillars.name: Made to Last
pillars.why: Silk lining, sweatband, woven label and leather band justify the price and give macro content that gets saved.

pillars.name: Coast & Shadow
pillars.why: Beach, Atlantic and hard-shadow editorial imagery gives the brand a look people recognize.

pillars.name: The Apparel Drop
pillars.why: The new apparel line gives a second launch moment and lower entry prices into the brand.

pillars.name: Worn In
pillars.why: Prompts, votes and #WornInTeddy turn followers into contributors and supply reshareable content.

cadence.feed: One feed post every day for 60 days: 24 Reels, 18 Carousels, 18 Static posts. Selected statics also pinned to Pinterest.
cadence.stories: A 2–5 frame story sequence every day using interactive stickers (polls, quizzes, question boxes, product and link stickers); reshare the day's feed post in stories.
cadence.reels: 24 Reels, cross-posted natively to TikTok (re-upload without the Instagram watermark, TikTok-native text). Reels run 16–27s with on-screen text so they work with the sound off.
cadence.best_times: Start with 7–9am and 6–8pm ET on weekdays, 9–11am ET on weekends. Treat these as a test: check Instagram Insights after week 2 and move to the top two windows.

do: Short, declarative lines. Say what it is and stop.
Name the real details: 100% wool, gold silk lining, leather band, metal button, woven label.
Give prices plainly and point to the exact product page.
A little Western swagger, delivered dry.
Ground it in place: Jupiter, the Atlantic, the four cities.
Ask one clear question per post when you want comments.
dont: Invent reviews, quotes, sales numbers, discounts, shipping promises or dates. Use [placeholders].
Put hashtags inside the caption copy; keep them in the hashtag block.
Post anyone's photo or handle without permission.

kpis.target: Week-over-week growth every week; record the week 1 baseline as [baseline]

kpis.target: Studio is the #1 social landing page during Days 8–21
Every prompt post (Days 6, 12, 14, 21, 54) beats the account's average comment count
At least [target] tagged posts by Day 60, with enough permissions to reshare one per day in stories
